com.nttdocomo.ui
Interface SoftKeyListener

All Superinterfaces:
EventListener
public interface SoftKeyListener
extends EventListener

This defines the soft key input listener. The soft key listener interface defines the interface that shall be implemented by the object that receives a soft key event in high level API.

See Also:
Panel
